note: Register imports and plans saved by old versions feed the joining-fee and start-day rules
The member app must show the new valid-till day; a renewal asked from the app must not be sold twice

why_not: Shows the member name and the valid-till day to people who already see that member; who sees a sale is written under F-panel-414

note: A cancelled plan with a cancelled receipt changes whether the joining fee is due; a member with many past plans must still get the right start

Two desks renewing one member from old lists would both start on the same day
The sheet words are plain text in the code, not passed through the translate helper used on the member page; whether another language reaches them was not checked
